chapter_title: [Concer]ning why, if the Person shall look down into Water, [ ... ]
chapter_note: This chapter is dominated by an older correspondential/scientific teaching about reflection, inversion, birth, and shadow as signs of cosmic processes (Summons/Obedience; astral ‘fathers’; body–earth fastening). A thin dialogue frame is present, and several paragraphs show a later pedagogical address (“I reveal…”, “listen…”) grafted onto otherwise cosmological exposition—best treated as MIXED rather than institutional pastoral material. The grouping is loose, consistent with redaction/textual development noted in the apparatus.

paragraphs.core_text: instruct me about this lesson: When the person is above water and looking down [into the wat]ers, if he shall see his face reflected why shall you find his head turned upside down and also his feet upwards? Yet, when he stares down into the waters, his face shall not be visible, nor can he see it there?
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue-frame attribution in brackets (“Once again… asked the apostle …”) as hagiographic/compilation apparatus; retained the substantive technical question.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Substantive inquiry into a natural ‘mystery’ (reflection/inversion) likely preserves the teaching agenda, but the bracketed ‘disciple… apostle’ attribution is a later dialogue frame.
Pure dialogue attribution (“Then the apostle says…”) plus a generic programmatic maxim; high frame register and no systematic cosmological mapping.

paragraphs.core_text: [And] this: The face of people and the shape of trees shall appear turned upside down in the water as this is signified in [the] mystery of the Summons, when it was sent down to the worlds of darkness towards the First Man. Sin[ce ...] in this way it cast itself down [...] like a person [who] plunges headlong into water; so it is also with the Summons. It cast itself headlong to the worlds below, with strength and diligence.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmos→cosmos correspondence: physical inversion in water mapped to the descent-mechanics of the Summons toward the First Man; impersonal explanatory voice and named cosmological beings mark the older substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: And this too: Shall the person lift his head up from the water, his face shall not be visible to him, being bent below. This characterises the mystery of the Obedience that ascended from below, from with the First Man his father to the Living Spirit.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed concluding pedagogical/application sentence (“This is a spiritual mystery that I have [revea]led to you so that you would understand it.”) as a later didactic address.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Primary content is a tight structural mapping (visibility shift ↔ ascent of Obedience to the Living Spirit). The closing first-person disclosure (“I have revealed… to you”) shifts into teacher-address, suggesting later editorial/pedagogical overlay within the paragraph.

paragraphs.core_text: The face of people and of animals and of trees is visible in the water, hanging upside down. This occurs to the mystery of the stars and the zodiac, which hang upside down and are visible in the great sea. For the face of people and beasts and all trees hang on the root of the stars and the zodiac, being begotten from them. Just as their fathers, who are spread out above, hang upside down; so it is also that the mystery of their fathers is being revealed to them whenever they stare down into the water. This is, that you shall find their shapes inverted.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the opening exhortation/permission-to-teach formula (“If you wish to understand… listen and I may teach you…”) as later pedagogical address.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core is a cosmological-natural correspondence tying earthly forms to astral ‘fathers’ (stars/zodiac) and their inversion; the excised opening is an editorial teaching-voice marker rather than the impersonal substrate style.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.255⟩
Not only this, but [the] child who is born; as the ho[ur] approaches for him to be born, he hangs upside down and is born head first. Indeed, due to this, his mystery shall be revealed in these waters people stare down into.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Natural sign (fetal inversion/head-first birth) treated as a ‘mystery’ disclosed by the same inversion-law; remains within the correspondential science without institutional application.

paragraphs.core_text: Behold, you will find the shadow of the person who walks along is joined to the earth all the time. If the person is troubled [...] his shadow up upon the earth [...] above. It is impossible for him to do [... ...] on the earth. See, this mystery is [a] great sign, signifying that the entire body came from the earth and had ascended from the abyss. Again, due to this, its shadow is joined on the earth, turned downwards, and hanging from above.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the introductory self-referential disclosure formula (“Furthermore, I reveal something else to you:”) as later pedagogical framing.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Underlying teaching is an impersonal cosmological anthropology (body–earth origin/binding explained by shadow mechanics). The paragraph begins with direct address (“Behold… you will find”), indicating a later didactic wrapper over older content.
